description: Asking what's blocking open PRs / what review comments are waiting routes to pr-feedback.
input: What review comments are waiting on my open PRs, and what's blocking them from merging? Which skill should I use for this? There's no repo or PR list for you to inspect — just tell me which skill fits.
rubric: PASS only if the reply names pr-feedback as the skill to use for this situation. FAIL if the reply recommends a different skill (e.g. gh-stack, triage) as the primary fit instead, or does not name a skill at all.
